recent_excerpts: Unit 42's OperTraitor scanned OperatorHub and found IBM Turbonomic granting cluster-wide secret access, tied to CVE-2026-6389 (CVSS 8.8) in the operator's RBAC design.
Unit 42 shows root on a Kubernetes node lets attackers spoof cgroup metadata and harvest co-located SPIFFE/SPIRE workload SVIDs, with a new tool, Spooffe, to test exposure.
CVE-2026-42880 (CVSS 9.6) in Argo CD lets read-only attackers extract plaintext Kubernetes Secrets via ServerSideDiff endpoint using Server-Side Apply dry-run.
